import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = json.loads((ROOT / 'variant-25/frozen-source.json').read_text())['commit']
REPO = 'MartinHalvorson/CIVVIS'
PREFIX = 'docs/eval/2026-10-17-conquest-campaign-capacity'


def command(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(arguments, text=True).strip()


def green_guard():
    current = json.loads(command('gh', 'pr', 'view', '4093', '--repo', REPO, '--json', 'headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,headRefName,body'))
    assert current['headRefOid'] == SOURCE
    checks = current['statusCheckRollup']
    assert len(checks) >= 8 and all(check['status'] == 'COMPLETED' and check['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS' for check in checks)
    workflows = json.loads(command('gh', 'run', 'list', '--repo', REPO, '--branch', current['headRefName'], '--limit', '100', '--json', 'databaseId,headSha,workflowName,status,conclusion'))
    relevant = [run for run in workflows if run['headSha'] == SOURCE]
    assert relevant and all(run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' for run in relevant)
    assert current['body'] == (ROOT / 'pr-body-checkpoint-25-results.txt').read_text()
    remote = command('git', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/' + current['headRefName']).split()[0]
    assert remote == SOURCE
    return {'head': SOURCE, 'checks': checks, 'runs': relevant, 'remote': remote}


assert command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == SOURCE
branch = command('git', 'branch', '--show-current')
assert branch == 'agent/mbp-m5-max-128/codex-conquest-1016/conquest-campaign-capacity-20261017T172623Z-ecd1'
assert not command('git', 'diff', '--name-only', SOURCE, '--', 'src', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
assert not command('git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
analysis = json.loads((ROOT / 'variant-25/development-analysis.json').read_text())
assert analysis['all_six_complete'] and len(analysis['cases']) == 6
metadata = json.loads((ROOT / 'checkpoint25-results-body-final-ci.json').read_text())
assert metadata['head'] == SOURCE
assert {run['workflowName'] for run in metadata['new_metadata_runs']} == {'collaboration-policy', 'overwrite-guard'}
assert all(run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' for run in metadata['new_metadata_runs'])
filenames = [PREFIX + suffix for suffix in ['.progress.json', '.checkpoint-25.delta.provenance.json.gz', '.checkpoint-25.parent-comparison.json', '.checkpoint-25.backup-recovery.json']]
progress = json.loads(Path(filenames[0]).read_text())
assert progress['execution_counts']['development_executions'] == 150
assert progress['execution_counts']['completed_resource_diagnostic_executions'] == 90
receipt = json.loads((ROOT / 'archive-checkpoint-25-verification.json').read_text())
assert Path(receipt['archive']).resolve() == Path(filenames[1]).resolve()
content = Path(receipt['archive']).read_bytes()
assert len(content) == receipt['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == receipt['sha256']
supplement = progress['variant_25_parent_comparison_supplement']
assert supplement['repository_path'] == filenames[2]
assert len(Path(filenames[2]).read_bytes()) == supplement['bytes']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(filenames[2]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == supplement['sha256']
before = green_guard()
with (ROOT / 'checkpoint25-results-precommit-guard.json').open('x') as output:
    json.dump(before, output, indent=2)
subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '--', *filenames], check=True)
assert sorted(command('git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only').splitlines()) == sorted(filenames)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Archive funded noncapital science and complete fixed-map evidence', '-m', 'Computer: MacBook Pro'], check=True)
head = command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
assert not command('git', 'diff', '--name-only', SOURCE, head, '--', 'src', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
assert not command('git', 'status', '--porcelain')
before_push = green_guard()
with (ROOT / 'checkpoint25-results-prepush-guard.json').open('x') as output:
    json.dump(before_push, output, indent=2)
subprocess.run(['git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'], check=True)
for attempt in range(45):
    graphql = json.loads(command('gh', 'pr', 'view', '4093', '--repo', REPO, '--json', 'headRefOid'))
    rest = json.loads(command('gh', 'api', f'repos/{REPO}/pulls/4093'))
    remote = command('git', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/' + branch).split()[0]
    if graphql['headRefOid'] == head and rest['head']['sha'] == head and remote == head:
        marker = {'head': head, 'source_policy_unchanged_from': SOURCE, 'pushed_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'candidate_executions_added': 0, 'fresh_executions_added': 0, 'push_attempts': 1, 'remote_branch_sha': remote, 'rest_pr_head': rest['head']['sha'], 'graphql_pr_head': graphql['headRefOid']}
        with (ROOT / 'variant-25-docs-pushed.json').open('x') as output:
            json.dump(marker, output, indent=2)
        print('Documentation-only backup single push fully acknowledged', head, flush=True)
        break
    time.sleep(2)
else:
    raise TimeoutError('Single push outcome not fully acknowledged; reconcile without repushing')

import ast
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def create(name, content):
    filename = ROOT / name
    assert not filename.exists()
    if filename.suffix == '.py':
        ast.parse(content)
    operation = '*** Add File: ' + str(filename) + '\n' + ''.join('+' + line + '\n' for line in content.splitlines())
    subprocess.run(['apply_patch'], input='*** Begin Patch\n' + operation + '*** End Patch\n', text=True, check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    assert filename.read_text() == content


def bump(content):
    for old, new in [('variant_24', 'variant_25'), ('variant-24', 'variant-25'), ('source-v24', 'source-v25'), ('checkpoint24', 'checkpoint25'), ('checkpoint-24', 'checkpoint-25'), ('Source24', 'Source25')]:
        content = content.replace(old, new)
    return content


for phase in ['proposal', 'final']:
    source = (ROOT / f'audit_variant_24_{phase}_overlap.py').read_text()
    source = bump(source).replace('Proposal24', 'Proposal25').replace('Final24', 'Final25')
    source = source.replace("    'reserve_conquest_capital_science',", "    'reserve_conquest_capital_science',\n    'conquest_campaign_noncapital_science_item',")
    create(f'audit_variant_25_{phase}_overlap.py', source)
validation = bump((ROOT / 'validate_variant_24.sh').read_text()).replace('capital-science-v24', 'noncapital-science-v25').replace('--lib conquest_campaign_capital_science', '--lib conquest_campaign_noncapital_science').replace('genuine16/4 parent20 Noop RED', 'genuine6/4 parent24 Noop RED')
create('validate_variant_25.sh', validation)
runner = bump((ROOT / 'commit_and_run_variant_24.sh').read_text())
runner = runner.replace('"$ROOT/checkpoint25_validation_metadata.py"', '"$ROOT/checkpoint25_metadata.py" validation')
runner = runner.replace('git add -- src/ai/advanced.rs ', 'git add -- ')
runner = runner.replace('= 5\n', '= 4\n')
runner = runner.replace('Reserve the capital science foundation before uninvested obsolete deterrence', 'Fund safe noncapital science behind the unchanged capital reservation')
runner = runner.replace('compare_capital_science_24.py', 'compare_capital_science_25.py').replace('audit_frontline_delivery_24.py', 'audit_frontline_delivery_25.py').replace('pack_checkpoint_24.py', 'pack_checkpoint_25.py')
runner = runner.replace('"$ROOT/compare_campaign_variants.py" variant-20 variant-25', '"$ROOT/compare_campaign_variants.py" variant-24 variant-25')
assert 'pr-body-checkpoint-25-validation.txt' in runner
assert 'pr-body-checkpoint-24-' not in runner and 'checkpoint25_validation_metadata.py' not in runner
assert 'git add -- src/ai/advanced/conquest_campaign.rs' in runner
assert '= 4\n' in runner
subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=runner, text=True, check=True)
create('commit_and_run_variant_25.sh', runner)
mechanism = (ROOT / 'compare_capital_science_24.py').read_text().replace('variant-24', 'variant-25').replace('variant-20', 'variant-24')
mechanism = mechanism.replace("for conquest's capital science foundation", "for conquest's capital-first science foundation")
mechanism = mechanism.replace('capital_science_ordinary_produce_claims_not_completion', 'capital_first_science_ordinary_produce_claims_not_completion').replace('body03/18', 'body03/24/25').replace('orders03/18', 'orders03/24/25')
marker = "        'boundaries': boundaries,"
addition = """        'science_infrastructure_at_fixed_boundaries': [{'turn': row['turn'], 'own_campuses': sum(entry['city']['owner'] == 0 and 'campus' in entry['city']['districts'] for entry in row['cities']), 'own_libraries': sum(entry['city']['owner'] == 0 and 'library' in entry['city']['buildings'] for entry in row['cities']), 'founded_noncapital_campuses': sum(entry['city']['owner'] == 0 and entry['city']['original_owner'] == 0 and not entry['city']['is_capital'] and 'campus' in entry['city']['districts'] for entry in row['cities']), 'founded_noncapital_libraries': sum(entry['city']['owner'] == 0 and entry['city']['original_owner'] == 0 and not entry['city']['is_capital'] and 'library' in entry['city']['buildings'] for entry in row['cities'])} for row in snapshots if row['turn'] in [40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110, 120]],
"""

backup = backup.replace('Archive capital-science reservations and complete fixed-map evidence', 'Archive funded noncapital science and complete fixed-map evidence')

wrapper = bump((ROOT / 'backup_checkpoint24_after_source_ci.py').read_text()).replace('source-v25-pipeline-prepush-resumed.log', 'source-v25-pipeline.log')
